title: De kar alam jo sheh
body:
de kar alam jo sheh ne hyder bana diya
saqqa ne saara saahil khyber bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye ali to rab ne khush aamdeed keh kar
deewar may haram ki ek dar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
saj kar imambara hum ye samajh rahe hai
jannat ke raaste may ek ghar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehnayi ja rahi hai dunya may mannato se
abid ne hathkadi ko zewar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
mehshar bapa kiye hai do ungliyan ali ki
bachon ka ek gharonda khyber bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
naame yazeed dar dar phirta hai moo chupaye
aisa hussain tumne be-ghar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne mujahidon ko saj kar hussain ne bhi
salman bana diya hai buzar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ki suja'at saahil pa koi dekhe
hyder se milta jhulta tewar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
mimbar pa jaa ke khoon may mursal e murtaza ko
maula bana ke sab se bar-tar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
madhe ali ki khaatir kitne hi meesamo ne
dunya may sooliyon ko mimbar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
<<DIVIDER>>
kismat ne mujhko mahir meraaj baksh di hai
mujhko ghulame shaah e qambar bana diya hai
de kar alam jo sheh ne...
author: Mahir Lakhnavi
